evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Tube pressure was 2.999 Torr early in growth.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.152 Torr with approximately constant argon flow; no pressure tolerance or normal-run reference is provided to establish a fault.
Temperature 750.2 °C and argon flow 100.3 sccm track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; controller reports running, but this does not verify atmosphere composition.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth pressure limits would clarify the pressure trend. Sample characterization is not yet available.
